name: Water Muffins
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fresh strong yeast
ingredients.originalText: four table-spoonfuls of fresh strong yeast

instructions.text: Put four table-spoonfuls of fresh strong yeast into a pint of lukewarm water
Add a little salt; about a small tea-spoonful
Stir in gradually as much sifted flour as will make a thick batter
Cover the pan, and set it in a warm place to rise
When it is quite light, and your griddle is hot, grease and set your muffin rings on it; having first buttered them round the inside
Dip out a ladle full of the batter for each ring, and bake them over a quick fire
Send them to table hot, and split them by pulling them open with your hands

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put four table-spoonfuls of fresh strong yeast into a pint of lukewarm water
2. Add a little salt; about a small tea-spoonful
3. Stir in gradually as much sifted flour as will make a thick batter
4. Cover the pan, and set it in a warm place to rise
5. When it is quite light, and your griddle is hot, grease and set your muffin rings on it; having first buttered them round the inside
6. Dip out a ladle full of the batter for each ring, and bake them over a quick fire
7. Send them to table hot, and split them by pulling them open with your hands
